profile.headline: Software Engineer at Northrop Grumman
profile.summary: Software Engineer with experience in C++, Java, and cross-language system integrations. Skilled in debugging, automation, and solving complex technical challenges. In addition to my engineering background, I’ve contributed to NFL game day operations, coordinating logistics and ensuring smooth execution of high-pressure events. This mix of technical expertise and operational leadership enables me to adapt quickly, solve problems, and deliver results across diverse environments. I’m excited to continue growing in roles that combine engineering expertise with leadership, teamwork, and client collaboration.

positions.title: Test Engineer/Software Engineer
positions.description:
CTSi provides world-class technical services focused on technical solutions for the Department of Defense, NASA, and our commercial customers. CTSi is known for innovative, rapid development and close working relationships with our customers.

- Refactored source code to latest operating systems and integrated development systems
- Modeled and simulated capabilities and integration of GPS simulators and receivers
- Worked with Navy personnel, in planning ,testing and integration of Modernized GPS User Equipment

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
CTSI aims to make a big difference and contribute to developing and fielding future state-of-the-art sensor platforms for railroad operations.

 -Derived and evaluated various open-source algorithms that detect and classify rail obstructions for safe locomotive operations
-Worked with various Electro-Optical APIS integrating multiple sensors allowing us to communicate and stream large amounts of image data
- Configured multiple IP's and VLANS for a platform with high resolution electro-optical sensors 
-Provided prompt solutions and proactive troubleshooting to any issues as part of a cohesive software team

positions.title: Game Day Operations Specialist
positions.description:
Zebra empowers those on the front line in retail, healthcare, transportation and logistics, manufacturing and other industries to achieve a performance edge - an edge that translates to delighted customers, good patient outcomes and superior business results.  

Responsibilities Include:
    -Responsible for game day execution at StubHub Center and SoFi Stadium, measuring and tracking real-time performance of each individual player, and equipment.
    -Manage and troubleshoot the program logistics across multiple external and internal team members.
    -Inspect and activate data tags for all NFL team members, referees and equipment, in order to 
      accurately record all data. 
    -Monitor software operations for the broadcast integration and ensuring there is no interference with satellite frequencies.

positions.title: Server/Bartender
positions.description:
-Manage and operate a fast pace bar environment.
-Responsible for training new employees on all our product offerings (food and alcohol).
-Exceeding customers expectations by providing great customer service.
-Being able to adapt, communicate and engage across a diverse audience.

volunteerExperiences.description:
"Embrace is a nonprofit organization rooted in mobilizing college students to serve less fortunate members of civilian and military veteran communities.    

Founded in 2000 by CEO Sean Sheppard, Embrace programs are designed to connect college student leaders to San Diego’s multi-cultural community in the areas of social and physical wellness through service learning and volunteerism. The organization is built on the philosophy that serving less fortunate members of society brings people together - irrespective of their race, religion or  cultural upbringing." -Embrace

-Gave a hand to those of embrace on a weekly basis for two years and helped feed and clothe the less fortunate in Downtown San Diego.
-Helped Embrace with cleaning up the streets in the near by area.

"The Color Run™ is a next generation events company delivering mass participation social experiences. Since 2012 we have had over 6 million people in more than 40 countries participate in The Color Run alone, making it the single largest sporting event in the world. We started a global movement, bringing people together to celebrate health, happiness, and inclusivity." - Color Run Event Services

- Assisted the Color Run workers in organizational tasks as needed, such as arriving hours prior to the event in order to help set up.
- Made sure all checkpoints were fully equipped with various equipment throughout the event, motivated and cheered on the runners as they passed each one.
-Helped various local sponsors in setting up their booths.
